::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** Decr 29th [1873?]  
**From:** Elderfield,  Otterbourne,  Winchester.  
**Manuscript:** MS Princeton University, Parrish Collection C0171: Box 29
:::

My dear [Miss Weber](people/person_1483.qmd)

It is a beautiful story, and I shall be very glad to have it for next year -i.e. Jany 1875[^1]

Yours truly
C M Yonge

---

[^1]: Since CMY would hardly have to particularize that next year meant 1875 if writing in 1874, and the end of December would be too late to get a story into the following January's issue of *MP*, it seems likely that this was written in 1873.  No story by Weber appeared in January 1875, but the one referred to here might be 'I Wonder Why',  published in November 1874.
